opening: The pain is tender, pulling (tugging), cramping and exhausting.
I'm quite short of breath; it's hard to breathe.
I'm tired all the time or my sleep isn't restful.
I feel lightheaded and dizzy or faint.
I'm taking one of the new oral blood thinners (a NOAC).
Someone in my family has been diagnosed with anemia.

opening.text: I have pain that came on slowly. It feels tender, pulling, cramping, and exhausting, and I'd rate it 5 out of 10. I'm also quite short of breath, it's hard to breathe, and I feel tired all the time or my sleep isn't restful. I feel lightheaded and dizzy or faint. I have chronic kidney failure and I'm taking one of the new oral blood thinners. Someone in my family has been diagnosed with anemia.
